oracle: a folder goes to the Trash with everything beneath it (A14.5, SPEC §4)
what: trashFolder trashes the folder and nothing in it (functions/src/lib/trash.ts), so its documents stay readable inside a folder in the Trash

target.case: A14.5 actions menus: Rename keeps the docId; Move to Trash is the owner's, with an Undo that brings it back, and /organize's trash is 403 to an editor and the absent id's 404 to a stranger; a folder asks first, goes to the Trash with everything beneath it, and Trash restores it whole
